extraction.method: extract exact ELF64 EM_AMDGPU bytes from measured PE executable using checked ELF section extents; not a recompiled object

compiled_isa.selection: source-bound calibrator candidate wrappers; runtime prefix arguments and fixed unsigned <20,3> or signed/unsigned <20,1> quad specializations; includes narrow public Garner controls; not a dynamic profiler trace
compiled_isa.fp_mode_decode: HSA 64-byte kernel descriptor compute_pgm_rsrc1 at byte48; F32 rounding bits13:12=0 RNE, denorm bits17:16; mode writes inspected separately
compiled_isa.limits: static instruction sites/resources/descriptor modes; no achieved occupancy, dynamic instruction counts, launches or hardware traffic
